name: marquee
description: infinite scrolling band, for a ticker or a row of pieces. speed is px/s and the duration is derived from the measured content width, so a short label and a long sentence travel at the same rate. the copy count is computed from the container width rather than hardcoded, so narrow content never leaves a hole. only the first copy is real to assistive tech and the keyboard (repeats are aria-hidden and inert), it pauses on hover and on focus-within so a link you tabbed to holds still, and under reduced motion it becomes a plain horizontal scroller of one copy so nothing past the edge is lost.
